blocks.text: Although the carried-over metadata still points backward, the page itself opens a new movement: the episode about the slaughter at Morinda. It is set in the year of great massacre, after the Khalsa has already disciplined the Brars and begun moving toward fresh enemies.

Ala Singh joined the Khalsa with his Phulkian following, and the combined force starts to measure where vengeance should next fall. The narrative broadens from one local feud into a coordinated misl action shaped by memory of earlier wrongs.

That inquiry leads the Singhs toward Morinda, where the town's Muslim officials are singled out as especially guilty in the chain of events around the younger Sahibzadas. The page therefore serves as both a fresh episode opening and a moral briefing for the assault to come.
